nodes.name: Desktop cockpit
nodes.purpose: Native Windows app with mission console, STOP, owner review, logs
nodes.acceptance: Launch a 700x500 GUI and run a harmless local action with local owner opt-in

nodes.name: Policy and permission broker
nodes.purpose: Per-skill capabilities, exact scoped approvals, kill switch and undo ledger
nodes.acceptance: Unapproved write/network/GUI/send requests are rejected even when an agent asks

nodes.name: Task engine and source provenance
nodes.purpose: Typed mission DAG, dependency, leases, outcome distinctions and source links
nodes.acceptance: After interruption, unknown send state cannot be silently retried

nodes.name: ChatGPT single-tab companion
nodes.purpose: Selected Chrome ChatGPT thread, browser handoff and reply receipt
nodes.acceptance: Owner-selected one-thread round trip shows exact message and complete reply without duplicate

nodes.name: Windows hands: UI Automation
nodes.purpose: v0.5 builds on owner-approved Notepad window identity and mouse source; a fixed PowerShell UI Automation probe reads button/menu/tab/toolbar names and IDs only (no document values); broader app navigation remains planned; no HP native test
nodes.acceptance: Navigate two allowlisted apps and verify focus and control state on physical HP

nodes.name: Visual mouse and perception
nodes.purpose: v0.5 adds a fixed owner-approved foreground untitled Notepad screenshot via Windows GDI, in-memory PNG and before/after pixel diff with focus/STOP gates; only synthetic UI tests passed; no OCR, AI image interpretation, auto upload or general app navigation
nodes.acceptance: Window movement and DPI tests do not send keys to the wrong app; STOP interrupts

nodes.name: Chrome general browser worker
nodes.purpose: Per-tab browser tasks, DOM and keyboard automation, downloads with provenance
nodes.acceptance: Use a harmless test site/form; handle UI change and login gate

nodes.name: Google workspace connector
nodes.purpose: Authorized Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Gmail tasks through approved providers or UI
nodes.acceptance: Read one opted-in Google source, produce provenance receipt, never leak token

nodes.name: Multilanguage code lab
nodes.purpose: v0.3 owner-selected file language/sha/line counts and Python/JSON syntax parsing; PATH runtime inventory only. Actual multilingual code execution still planned
nodes.acceptance: Compile/lint/run safe workspace tests in each installed toolchain; refuse missing runtime

nodes.name: Skill registry and switches
nodes.purpose: v0.3 local persisted ON/OFF for five fixed reviewed skills, dependency/version checks and inactive draft quarantine. Dynamic plugin code execution still planned
nodes.acceptance: Turn approved read-only skill on and off and deny dependency/permission violation

nodes.name: Skill forge and evaluation
nodes.purpose: v0.3 stages INERT user-specified Python/PowerShell/JS skill ideas as private validated draft manifests; actual self-authored code, sandbox tests and skill activation still planned
nodes.acceptance: Given missing feature, generate draft + tests; fail skill stays off; approved passes only

nodes.name: Agent nest / worker activation
nodes.purpose: Planner, coder, operator, researcher, verifier roles; spawn/stop scoped workers
nodes.acceptance: Spawn bounded worker, delegate task, collect receipt; child cannot exceed parent rights

nodes.name: Self-discovery / invention radar
nodes.purpose: Identify friction, suggest unrequested abilities, prototype and benchmark alternatives
nodes.acceptance: Recurrent failure yields testable capability proposal with evidence, not self-install

nodes.name: Memory, receipts and private indexing
nodes.purpose: Local metadata journal, source-linked knowledge and owner-private context store
nodes.acceptance: Restart recovers pending status without publishing private logs

nodes.name: Recovery, simulation and safety monitor
nodes.purpose: v0.3 unknown-send and restart receipt holds with owner-review clearing. Live crash/STOP acceptance and OS process interruption still planned
nodes.acceptance: Crash, account switch, duplicate send and STOP tests fail safely

nodes.name: External skill ingestion
nodes.purpose: Download-free-first review, signature/hash/license provenance, quarantine and tests
nodes.acceptance: Untrusted plugin cannot gain network/shell/credential permissions automatically

nodes.name: Operator learning/teach mode
nodes.purpose: Owner records a bounded workflow; Spider converts to selectors and tests
nodes.acceptance: Replays workflow after window position change, without hard-coded coordinates

nodes.name: Phone companion and remote status
nodes.purpose: Private read-only status and explicit owner approvals on iPhone
nodes.acceptance: No public HP listener or private chat export; remote commands only after authenticated design

rules.skill_auto_activation: Only for already-trusted, preapproved scopes; never for new filesystem writes, identity, payments, credentials or broad shell access
rules.agent_spawn: Child gets a strictly narrowed subset of approved parent permissions, finite budgets, an expiry and an immediate STOP channel
rules.one_browser_writer: Do not run Spider ChatGPT writer concurrently with AUTO-08/Master Continuation Switch
